'''''UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit''''' (branded as '''''Polymarket UFC 334''''' for sponsorship reasons) was a [[mixed martial arts]] event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that took place on November 14, 2026, at [[Madison Square Garden]] in [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States.<ref name="NY">{{Cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/ufc-334-335-announced-dates-010404268.html|title=UFC announces 2 major shows and one has a big sponsor added to the title|publisher=sports.yahoo.com|author=Brian Mazique|date=2026-08-23|access-date=2026-08-23}}</ref>

==Background==
This event marked the promotion's 13th visit to New York City and first since [[UFC 322]] in November 2025.<ref name="NY"/>

A [[UFC Heavyweight Championship]] bout between current champion [[Ciryl Gane]] and undefeated contender [[Josh Hokit]] headlined the event.<ref name="main">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/511102/ciryl-gane-vs-josh-hokit-kayla-harrison-vs-amanda-nunes-title-fights-set-for-ufc-334|title=Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit, Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes title fights set for UFC 334|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-09-20|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref> On September 14, 2026, then-reigning champion [[Tom Aspinall]] vacated his heavyweight title due to ongoing complications from the eye injury he sustained via an illegal poke during his title defense against Gane in October 2025 at [[UFC 321]], which ended in a no contest.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/10/25/tom-aspinall-fuming-after-ufc-321-headliner-ends-early-due-to-ciryl-gane-eye-poke/|title=Tom Aspinall fuming after UFC 321 headliner ends early due to Ciryl Gane eye poke|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2025-10-25|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/tom-aspinall-vacates-ufc-heavyweight-title/|title=Tom Aspinall vacates UFC heavyweight title|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-09-14|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref> Gane was originally the interim champion after defeating former [[List of UFC champions#Middleweight Championship|UFC Middleweight]] and two-time [[UFC Light Heavyweight Championship|UFC Light Heavyweight]] champion [[Alex Pereira]] on June 14, 2026 at [[UFC Freedom 250]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/06/15/ufc-freedom-250-ciryl-gane-lights-up-devastates-alex-pereira-spoiling-heavyweight-debut/|title=UFC Freedom 250: Ciryl Gane lights up, devastates Alex Pereira, spoiling heavyweight debut|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2026-06-15|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref> Although CEO [[Dana White]] originally said Gane would not be elevated to undisputed champion, White later clarified that he misspoke and confirmed that Gane had indeed been promoted and would enter this bout as the defending champion.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/511027/dana-white-says-ciryl-gane-wont-be-promoted-to-undisputed-champion-hes-still-got-to-fight|title=Dana White says Ciryl Gane won't be promoted to undisputed champion: 'He's still got to fight'|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Jed Meshew|date=2026-09-19|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/ufc/ciryl-gane-next-fight-josh-hokit-tom-aspinall-b3053028.html|title=Ciryl Gane crowned UFC heavyweight champion and defends title vs controversial Josh Hokit|publisher=independent.co.uk|author=Alex Pattle|date=2026-09-20|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref>

A [[UFC Women's Bantamweight Championship]] bout between the reigning champion [[Kayla Harrison]] (who is also a [[Judo at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's 78 kg|2012]] and [[Judo at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Women's 78 kg|2016 Olympic gold medalist in judo]]; and a two-time [[Professional Fighters League|PFL]] women's lightweight tournament champion) and former two-time champion [[Amanda Nunes]], who also held the [[UFC Women's Featherweight Championship]], co-headlined the event.<ref name="main"/> Nunes, who is widely considered the greatest women's fighter in UFC history, returned for her first bout since [[UFC 289]] in June 2023, where she announced her retirement following a successful title defense against [[Irene Aldana]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/c6e3dw87pyjeo|title=The challenge that brought Nunes out of retirement|publisher=bbc.com|author=Paul Battison|date=2026-11-14|access-date=2026-11-14}}</ref> The bout was originally scheduled for [[UFC 324]] in January 2026, but Harrison withdrew from the bout after being diagnosed with herniated discs in her neck, which required surgery.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/466164/report-kayla-harrison-out-of-ufc-324-fight-against-amanda-nunes-postponed-to-later-date|title=Kayla Harrison out of UFC 324, fight against Amanda Nunes postponed to later date|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2026-01-14|access-date=2026-09-18}}</ref> The bout was also reportedly linked to [[UFC 331]], which took place in September, but it did not materialize for undisclosed reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/08/01/arman-tsarukyan-reportedly-wont-be-allowed-to-challenge-for-charles-oliveiras-bmf-title-at-ufc-331/|title=Arman Tsarukyan reportedly won't be allowed to challenge for Charles Oliveira's BMF title at UFC 331|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Harvey Leonard|date=2026-08-01|access-date=2026-09-18}}</ref> [[Joselyne Edwards]] served as backup and potential replacement for this fight.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/518223/joselyne-edwards-to-serve-as-backup-fighter-for-kayla-harrison-vs-amanda-nunes-at-ufc-334|title=Joselyne Edwards to serve as backup fighter for Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes at UFC 334|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Guilherme Cruz|date=2026-10-28|access-date=2026-10-28}}</ref>

Undefeated prospects Donte Johnson and Baisangur Susurkaev were scheduled to fight at the event in a middleweight bout.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/ufc-334-gane-hokit-officially-announced/|title=UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit officially announced|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-09-19|access-date=2026-09-20}}</ref> However, Susurkaev withdrew from the bout for unknown reasons and was replaced by [[César Almeida (fighter)|César Almeida]] in a catchweight of 190 pounds.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/513222/ufc-334-loses-top-middleweight-prospect-cesar-almeida-steps-in|title=UFC 334 loses top middleweight prospect, Cesar Almeida steps in|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-09-29|access-date=2026-09-30}}</ref> Almeida was fined 30 percent of his purse for asking for the bout to be moved to a catchweight bout.<ref name="bonuses"/>

A lightweight bout between [[Nazim Sadykhov]] and Jefferson Nascimento was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/First-UFC-334-fight-revealed-for-Madison-Square-Garden-card-202638|title=First UFC 334 fight revealed for Madison Square Garden card|publisher=sherdog.com|author=Sayan Nag|date=2026-09-03|access-date=2026-09-03}}</ref> However, Nascimento withdrew due to an injury, and Sadykhov subsequently withdrew due to a lingering injury of his own, resulting in the bout's cancellation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/UFC-334-loses-lightweight-bout-after-both-fighters-suffer-injuries-203118|title=UFC 334 loses lightweight bout after both fighters suffer injuries|publisher=sherdog.com|author=Sayan Nag|date=2026-10-08|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref>

[[Adrian Yañez]] and Juan Díaz were expected to meet in a bantamweight bout at the preliminary card.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/bantamweight-barnburner-added-to-ufc-334/|title=Bantamweight Barnburner Added to UFC 334 in New York|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-09-15|access-date=2026-09-15}}</ref> However, Yañez had to withdraw in mid October due to injury and was replaced by [[Alateng Heili]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sports.ndtv.com/us/us-streamers/ufc-334-fight-cancellation-adrian-yanez-withdraws-from-juan-diaz-bout-as-ufc-has-yet-to-name-replacement-12198639|title=UFC 334 fight cancellation: Adrian Yanez withdraws from Juan Diaz bout as UFC has yet to name replacement|publisher=sports.ndtv.com|author=NDTV Sports Desk|date=2026-10-17|access-date=2026-10-18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/ufc-334-card-gets-late-booking/|title=UFC 334 card gets late booking|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-11-06|access-date=2026-11-07}}</ref>

At the weigh-ins, two fighters missed weight:<ref name="miss">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/11/13/ufc-334-official-weigh-in-results-live-stream-gane-hokit-harrison-nunes/92634095007/|title=UFC 334 weigh-in results: Title fights set, but two misses in New York|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Staff|date=2026-11-13|access-date=2026-11-13}}</ref> 
*[[Terrance McKinney]] weighed in at 160.2 pounds, 4.2 pounds over the lightweight non-title fight limit.
*Díaz weighed in at 136.4 pounds, 0.4 pounds over the bantamweight non-title fight limit.

Both bouts proceeded at catchweight. The fighters were fined a percentage of their individual purses which went to their opponents [[Jim Miller (fighter)|Jim Miller]] (30 percent) and Alateng (20 percent), respectively.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/520891/ufc-334-weigh-in-results-1-fighter-misses-weight-by-over-4-pounds-championship-bouts-set|title=UFC 334 weigh-in results: 1 fighter misses weight by over 4 pounds, championship bouts set|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-11-14|access-date=2026-11-15}}</ref>

==Bonus awards==
The following fighters received $100,000 bonuses. Mesquita received $25,000 for her finish. Almeida and McKinney also achieved finishes in their respective fights but were ineligible for bonuses due to missing weight.<ref name="bonuses">{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/ufc-334-bonuses-revealed-following-event/|title=UFC 334 bonuses revealed following numbered event|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-11-15|access-date=2026-11-15}}</ref>
*'''Fight of the Night: Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit'''
*'''Performance of the Night: Kayla Harrison''' and '''Stephen Thompson'''
